segment_contamination_dimensions: Complete prefabricated building buyers (sibling: Prefabricated Buildings, Prefabricated Industrial Buildings, Prefabricated Warehouse, Prefabricated Steel Buildings) — buyers procuring full turnkey building structures rather than wall panel components; names implying a complete building or structure (e.g., 'prefabricated building', 'prefab shed', 'prefab structure') are blocked to prevent routing wall-panel buyers toward full-building MCATs.

Agricultural and horticultural structure buyers (siblings: Agricultural Greenhouses, Greenhouse, Polyhouse, Naturally Ventilated Greenhouse, Mini Greenhouse, Greenhouse Structure, Mist Chamber) — buyers seeking crop-growing enclosures with specific light-transmission and ventilation requirements; any name referencing greenhouse, polyhouse, or grow-tunnel contexts is blocked.

Tensile and membrane structure buyers (siblings: Tensile Structures, Modular Tensile Structure, Tensile Membrane Structures, Auditorium Tensile Structure, Gazebo Tensile Structure) — buyers seeking fabric/membrane canopy or shade structures; names referencing tensile, membrane, or fabric wall coverings are blocked.

Portable and temporary accommodation buyers (siblings: Portable Buildings, Temporary Buildings, Prefabricated Labor Colony, RCC Labour Quarter) — buyers procuring relocatable site offices or labour quarters as complete units rather than wall panel components; names implying portable cabins or labour colony units are blocked.

Modular complete-building buyers (sibling: Modular Buildings) — buyers seeking fully assembled modular room or building units; names implying a complete modular building rather than a wall panel system are blocked.
